description: This file defines a Calendar object for a DHTML calendar widget, including its constructor, methods for rendering, event handling, date parsing, and display logic. It also patches Date prototype methods for additional date computations.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Constructor for a DHTML calendar widget with methods for creation, display, event handling, and date parsing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates the calendar DOM elements inside a parent element or as a popup.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the calendar to a specific date, reinitializing the display.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the calendar display based on current date.

methods.name: showAt
methods.description: Shows the calendar at specific x, y coordinates.

methods.name: showAtElement
methods.description: Displays the calendar near a specific DOM element with optional alignment.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object and updates the calendar.

methods.name: setTtDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the tooltip date format string.

methods.name: callHandler
methods.description: Calls the user-defined onSelected handler with the current date.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the calendar DOM element and cleans up references.

methods.name: reparent
methods.description: Moves the calendar DOM element to a new parent in the DOM tree.
